claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: Not coded (excluded). Headline: an ImageNet-pretrained ShuffleNet-V2 classifier of pylon aesthetics (validation accuracy 92.59%) screens pylon layouts generated by the authors' two-stage TO network; results are shown as selected figures only.
claim.location: Abstract; Sec. 2.2 (classifier), Sec. 3 (TO network), Sec. 4, Sec. 5
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: Not coded (excluded at full text). No runtime, iteration count or hardware is reported for any method.

notes: Excluded as FT-MLONLY (first applicable code). The only comparisons are with other ML methods, and they are qualitative. Sec. 3 says the two-stage network balances efficiency, accuracy and generalization better than four ML TO methods: Xiang et al. 2022, Yan et al. 2023, Jeong et al. 2023 (PINNTO) and Mazé & Ahmed 2023. It also says the network needs far fewer training samples than Xiang et al. 2022 and Yan et al. 2023. No classical comparator is run, timed or cited. Classical TO (the 88-line code) serves only to generate the training layouts: 102 portal-type and 306 portal-truss pylons, 256 high and 64-128 wide, volume fraction 0.25-0.5 (Sec. 3). Its cost appears only as motivation (Abstract; Sec. 1; Sec. 5). No design-quality or accuracy number is reported for the TO networks (Fig. 5 shows selected examples). If a verifier does not count the qualitative ML comparisons, the next code is FT-NOBASELINE. Type check: the chapter is a conference paper (ICSA 2025 proceedings; PDF metadata and copyright line), so FT-TYPE does not apply. Related pool records: P00681 (Wang, Ning, Xiang & Chen 2024, EAAI 133:108185) holds the two-stage TO network that this paper reuses, and its classical comparisons, if any, are there. P00954 (Xiang, Chen, Wang & Ning, Structures 2025, aesthetic evaluation network for bridge pylons; LLM screening E-FORWARD) appears to overlap with Sec. 2 and 4 [inferred from titles]. Neither is coded, so FT-DUPLICATE was not used. Dataset and code: https://github.com/nnwyy/bridge_pylon_form_dataset (Sec. 2.2; not checked). Authors: C. Xiang (Fuzhou University), A.R. Chen, Y. Ning and D.L. Wang (Tongji University). No author named Jun Wang. Cheng Xiang and Dalei Wang, apparently the same people [inferred from names], co-author coded record P00176 (a different study). Screening code was I-SPEED.
